You mentioned Alex is 19 and doesn't live with you. A crucial factor for 16-19 year olds is whether they're in approved education or training. **Is Alex currently in approved education or training?** (This includes things like A-levels, Scottish Highers, NVQs up to level 3, or other approved courses.)

I can see Blake is 20 years old. Unfortunately, based on the Child Benefit rules, eligibility generally ends when a child turns 20, even if they're in approved education or training.
